name: Devil's Mark
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
body:
Drawbacks
Devil's Mark
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
Category Faction
You bear the stain of a higher fiend upon you, and any evil creature who sees it may think twice before crossing you. You gain a +2 trait bonus on all Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks when dealing with outsiders of the evil subtype.
